sources.title: Nantong Museum
sources.excerpt: Nantong Museum is located in Nantong, Jiangsu Province, China, at 19 Qixiu Road in Chongchuan District. It is near the center of the city, beside the Haohe river. It was established by a well-known educator, Zhang Jian in 1905. It is made of five parts, the center, the south, the north, the east, and the west. It is one of the oldest museums in China.
